messages:
sam: quick q — in PR #4829 I changed the JSON struct tags on the user response to `json:"user_id,omitempty"` vs `json:"userId,omitempty"`. Which convention do we want for public API payloads? cc @jin @nora
jin: for public-facing APIs we use camelCase (userId). backend-only/internal structs sometimes use snake_case but prefer consistency at the surface. 
 nora: yup +1 camelCase for responses. we did a short doc on this last year (api-style.md) — same rule as frontend.
 sam: got it. I'll switch to `userId`. also saw a `gofmt` and `golangci-lint` warning complaining about unused import after my refactor. should I fix lint + formatting in this PR or do a follow-up?
 andrew: small formatting/lint fixes are fine to include in the same PR if they're trivial. if it's a rename that touches other packages, split. in this case sounds fine to bundle.
 sam: cool — plan: 1) change tag to `userId`, 2) run `gofmt -w .`, 3) run `golangci-lint run` and fix quick nits.
 jin: sounds good. tiny nit request while you're at it: the struct field is `UserID string` — we usually use `ID string` for top-level resource structs (e.g., `User{ ID string }`). consistency > clever names. not blocking though.
 sam: ok i'll rename to `ID` and keep the json tag `userId`. i can push the branch in ~15m. @jin can you re-review after? :pray:
 nora: looks fine to me. +1 to renaming for consistency.
 jin: i'll re-review after CI passes. if tests/linters are green i'll approve.
 format-bot: build queued for PR #4829 — starting CI: test, lint, fmt.
 sam: pushed updates: renamed field, updated tags, ran gofmt, fixed lint nits. thanks all. pinging for review.
 jin: reviewing now, should be quick.
 jin: approved — only comment was optional: consider adding a small test for json marshalling shim, but not required. merging once CI passes. :thumbsup:
 format-bot: CI passed for PR #4829 — all checks green.
 sam: thanks everyone, merging now. :tada:
